tns:patch.author: bmokandu
tns:patch.description: Add order_index column to AMP_INDICATOR_DISAGGREGATION table to preserve user-selected disaggregation order. Existing rows get order_index assigned based on category_value_id order.

script.lang:
ALTER TABLE AMP_INDICATOR_DISAGGREGATION ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS order_index INTEGER;
UPDATE AMP_INDICATOR_DISAGGREGATION aid SET order_index = sub.rn FROM ( SELECT indicator_id, category_value_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY indicator_id ORDER BY category_value_id) - 1 AS rn FROM AMP_INDICATOR_DISAGGREGATION ) sub WHERE aid.indicator_id = sub.indicator_id AND aid.category_value_id = sub.category_value_id AND aid.order_index IS NULL
